name: Venser
title: The Shaper Savant
summary: An inventive mage whose teleportation experiments and emerging spark foreshadowed the post-Mending age.
biography: Venser grew up in Urborg, where he pursued the construction of devices capable of extraordinary transportation and displacement. His talents attracted the attention of Teferi and Lord Windgrace.
Drawn into the attempt to close Dominaria's rifts, he discovered that his own potential for planeswalking differed from the nearly limitless abilities of the older planeswalkers.
Venser survived the final repair of the Otarian rift and entered the new era as one of the first examples of a post-Mending planeswalker.

Venser's early experiments were technical as well as magical. His interest in teleportation devices made him an unusual companion for Teferi and Jhoira at a moment when veteran planeswalkers were trying to repair damage left by powers far greater than his own.

His emerging spark appeared within the larger crisis rather than after it was safely resolved. This timing matters because his experience challenged the assumption that planeswalking would always resemble the near-limitless existence of the older generation. The Mending transformed that relationship between ability and limitation.

His survival lets the chapter end with possibility as well as sacrifice. The disappearance or death of some established guardians changed the world, but inventors such as Venser still faced decisions about how to use their powers responsibly in the new order. His later history belongs to subsequent stories and should not be read back into his first journey.

featuredCard.significance: Venser's first legendary card, printed in Future Sight, reflects his talent for teleportation.
